subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CAKE' is written as '6874', 'EASY' is written as '4882'. How will 'MAKE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Position value of opposite letter according to English alphabetic series is written.
 
• Double digit position values are added within the number to make a single digit number.

So,

 
• 'CAKE' is written as '6874'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5dbabafe10eba17863f41f9cf22bd20927bdd197daf79db7dda6972b4e3bb03.png] 

And,

 
• 'EASY' is written as '4882'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ee11d9b3bfccb5736bc6385a54250b7800bd7dad648d3bd72cdf211c0e552c8.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'MAKE' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc1b711fd2c0401df492c1d2e7df55e203e85fef37545f42fd309e4514062d5.png] 

​Hence, "5874" is the correct answer.

70
